reason: Both count lunar rays or powers (மதியி நெழுங்கதிர், சோமனில் தோன்றுங் கலை). The specific numerical correspondence and its purpose need a textual witness.

DEVELOPS as a candidate. A distinguishes கேவலம், சகலம் and சுத்தம். B explicitly places three states within the sakala condition (சகலத்தில் இம்மூன்று). Have a specialist verify the technical subdivisions before accepting.
A distinguishes ஞானம், இச்சை and கிரியாசக்தி. B invokes a father and mother together and speaks of knowledge. B supplies insufficient evidence for A’s threefold account.

Flowers and water and யாவர் நினைக்கவல் லாரே in A concern grasping the deity’s gracious nature. B says the worshipping gods அறிகிலர். The difficulty of fully knowing Siva is broad and the agents differ.
Both pair musk (ம்ருகமத) with a question about erotic attachment, but the shared ornament and rhetorical turn could be conventional. Check frequency elsewhere before proposing SAME_IMAGE.
Perfumed water, narrow waists and spear-like eyes give several overlaps. The descriptions largely consist of conventional ornaments and neither passage establishes a further shared claim.

சித்த நோய்ப்புண் and பிணிதீராக் suggest affliction around sexual attachment, yet the two stanzas frame its cause differently. An English paraphrase calling both the same disease would overstate the evidence.

SAME_IMAGE as a candidate. Both make the moon and sounding sea distress a girl, then ask Murugan to intervene so she will not waste away (எனதருமின் ... இளையாதே and இச்சிறுமி ... மெலியாதே). This conjunction is more specific than a shared plea for grace. Check the wider love-poetry convention.
